signatureMoment.text: A low swoop over the viaduct leaves a vortex ribbon in the morning mist that dissipates over 6 seconds.

coreInteractionSentence: soar through the valley, sweep low over the river, watch the grass bend under your flight

extraSectionMarkdown.weather: Dynamic wind gusts alter rain shear and grass wave speed.
extraSectionMarkdown.water-bodies: A carved river spline with 3-step quantised painterly specular.
extraSectionMarkdown.architecture: A stone viaduct with 9 arches spanning 14 m each.
extraSectionMarkdown.destructibility: Impacts dislodge stone fragments from ancient ruins along the bank.
